<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="ex44042023-02-2308-08-03" type="excerpt" status="finalized"><milestone unit="section" n="20. tshad 'bras (15b2–15b7)"/>
            dang po grub mtha' dang sbyar ba ni ¦<quote source="db:5564"><rs type="school">bye brag tu smra ba</rs> ni ¦ <expan>gzugs sogs</expan> thug phrad du snang pa'i don dngos <expan>bzhugs</expan>¦ phyi don mthong pa tshad ma ¦ phyi don <expan>rtogs</expan> pa <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> pa <expan>'bras bur</expan> smra bas ¦ <expan>gzhal bya</expan> dang tshad 'bras <lb n="15b3"/> rdzas tha dad dus <expan>mnyam par</expan> 'dod ¦
            <rs type="school">mdo sde pa</rs>s ¦ don lkog na mo <expan>gzhal bya</expan> ¦ don dang 'dra bar skyes <expan>pa'i</expan> shes pa tshad ma ¦ don <expan>rtogs</expan> <expan>btags</expan> pa <expan>'bras bur</expan> smra bas <expan>gzhal bya</expan> dang tshad 'bras rdzas tha dad dus <choice><sic>mnyaM par</sic><corr>tha dad par</corr> </choice> 'dod do |
            <rs type="school">rnaM bden pa</rs>s ¦ bzung ba'i rnaM pa <expan>gzhal bya</expan> ¦ 'dzin pa'i rnaM pa tshad ma ¦ rang rig <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> pa <expan>'bras bur</expan> <lb n="15b4"/> 'dod pas ¦ <expan>gzhal bya</expan> dang tshad 'bras bde sdug myong ba ltar dus dang <expan>ngo bo</expan> <expan>gcig</expan> du 'dod do |
            <rs type="school">rnaM brdzun pa</rs>s bzung <expan>pa'i</expan> rnaM pa sgro <expan>btags</expan> <expan>gzhal bya</expan> ¦ 'dzin pa'i rnaM pa tshad ma ¦ rang rig <expan>btags</expan> pa ba <expan>'bras bur</expan> 'dod pas ¦ <expan>gzhal bya</expan> dang tshad <expan>'bras skra </expan>shad snang pa ltar <expan>gcig</expan> pa bkag <expan>pa'i</expan> tha dad du <expan>'dod do</expan></quote> ces <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5564">rigs gter</rs> <expan>las gsungs so</expan> ¦ <note type="editorial">This is not a literal citation.</note></seg></TEI>
